page.notes: Several Hebrew words are uncertain at this scan resolution, especially vowel points and the second word of entries 2, 3 and 9 ('Ponere', 'Propterea quod'). Their letters were copied as they appear but may contain errors; no [?] markers were added because the strokes are clear enough to read. The Hebrew headwords at the start of the entries are set in the text block, not in the margin, and are transcribed as main text. The Hebrew in the entry beginning 'שְׁחִי' and the entry ending 'Stultitia' are the least certain.
